title: Capterra Review Scraper
description: Extract verified Capterra product reviews from a product or reviews URL.

url.title: Capterra URL
url.description: Capterra product or reviews URL. Product URLs are automatically converted to the reviews page.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of reviews to collect.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of Capterra review pages to fetch. Each page usually contains up to 25 reviews.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies are recommended for Capterra.
